title: Amazon Product Intelligence Actor
description: Give the Actor ASINs, product URLs or keywords. Every input you provide is accounted for in the output: either a product record or a structured failure row explaining exactly what happened.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: fast = cheap extraction from search/listing pages. detail = full product page extraction (default).

marketplace.title: Marketplace
marketplace.description: Which Amazon marketplace to use. Product URLs from a different marketplace are respected and reported per record.

asins.title: ASINs
asins.description: One or more 10-character ASINs, e.g. B0CX23V2ZK. Invalid entries are returned as INVALID_INPUT rows rather than dropped.

urls.title: Amazon URLs
urls.description: Product, search, category or best-seller URLs. Storefront/seller input is planned for V1.2 and currently returns a structured INVALID_INPUT row.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Search keywords. Each keyword is crawled up to 'Max search pages'.

datasetId.title: Input dataset ID
datasetId.description: Read inputs from an existing Apify dataset instead of pasting them.

datasetField.title: Input dataset field
datasetField.description: Which field of the input dataset holds the ASIN or URL.

deliveryCountry.title: Delivery country
deliveryCountry.description: Optional delivery context. Amazon shows different prices and delivery promises by location.

postalCode.title: Postal code
postalCode.description: Optional postal code, e.g. 10001. Applied once per session and verified from the page. Every record reports whether it was applied.

requireLocation.title: Require the location to be applied
requireLocation.description: When on, a product whose delivery location could not be applied is returned as REQUIRES_LOCATION instead of a success with an unlocalized price. Recommended for price tracking.

variantMode.title: Variant mode
variantMode.description: none = skip. discover = child ASINs and option matrix at no extra request cost (default). price = also fetch each child's current price and stock. full = full detail per child.
enumTitles: Discover - child ASINs + options (no extra cost)
Price - child prices and stock (extra requests)
Full - full detail per child (most expensive)

maxProducts.title: Max products
maxProducts.description: Hard ceiling on products processed in this run.

maxVariants.title: Max variants per parent
maxVariants.description: Ceiling on deep child fetches. Discovery is unaffected.

deduplicate.title: Deduplicate results
deduplicate.description: Deduplicate on marketplace + ASIN + resolved delivery location. Discovery sources are merged into discoveredFrom rather than emitted twice.

allowResidentialFallback.title: Allow residential proxy fallback
allowResidentialFallback.description: When off, the Actor never escalates to residential proxies and returns BLOCKED instead. Cheaper and fully predictable, at a higher block rate.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Amazon requires proxies. High-volume users can supply their own external proxy URLs here, which keeps that traffic off the platform bill entirely.

schemaVersion.title: Expected schema version
schemaVersion.description: Echo of the output schema your integration expects. A mismatch produces a run warning, never a failure.
